Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearBaitEnabled_toolt: Lets players lay out honey or fish as bear bait in or right next to a forest. After one or more nights a cub may come.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearBaitFirstChance: Bear bait: chance on the first night
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearBaitFirstChance_t: Chance in percent that a cub comes after the first counted night. It rises evenly to 100 by the last night (default 40 / 70 / 100).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearBaitNights_toolti: At the latest after this many counted nights, a cub comes to the bait. A night only counts if nobody stood near the bait at dawn.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCallCooldownMinut: Real-time minutes between two uses of Call to me on the same cub.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubForestRate: Bear cub: how often in the forest
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubForestRate_too: How often an orphaned bear cub appears in or near a forest, out of sight, for a player who has no bear and no cub yet. Chance per in-game hour: rare 2%%, normal 5%%, often 12%%, very often 30%%.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubMaxDistance_to: A new cub appears at most this many tiles away from the player it appears for. At least the minimum + 5 and never more than 65, because the game only keeps about 76 tiles loaded around you.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubMinDistance_to: A new cub appears at least this many tiles away from every player.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubVanishHours: Bear cub: hours until it wanders off
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubVanishHours_to: A cub that was never fed wanders off after this many in-game hours without anybody near it. It never disappears in front of you. 0 = never.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubWorldCap: Bear cubs: wild cubs at once
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubWorldCap_toolt: At most this many untamed bear cubs exist in the world at the same time.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubsEnabled_toolt: Main switch. Off: no new bear cubs appear, neither in the forest nor at bait spots. Cubs that are already in the world can still be tamed.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearDeathLockDays_too: After your tamed bear dies, no new cub will trust you for this many in-game days.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearDodgeMax_tooltip: In percent. Agility level 0 dodges 5 percent of hits, level 10 this much. Agility rises with every hit the bear takes. Has no effect until bears can fight.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearFeedCooldownMinut: In-game minutes before the same cub can be fed again.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearFightBonusMax_too: In percent, on top of the damage from growing. Fighting rises with every hit the bear lands. Has no effect until bears can fight.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearFollowMaxDistance: Tiles. If the owner gets farther away than this, a following cub stops and waits there.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearGrowDays_tooltip: In-game days from taming until a cub is fully grown (size 1.35). It grows faster at first and slower later; good feeding speeds it up a little. Health, stamina, carrying capacity and damage rise every day with its size.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearHealAwake: Bear: healing per hour while awake
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearHealAwake_tooltip: Percent of its health a tamed bear heals per in-game hour on its own while awake.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearHealSleep: Bear: healing per hour while asleep
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearHealSleep_tooltip: Percent of its health per in-game hour while it sleeps. Has no effect until bears can sleep.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearLog_tooltip: Writes [TC-BEAR] diagnosis lines to the console. Only for bug reports; real errors are always written.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearMaxPerPlayer_tool: How many tamed bears one player may have.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearPetCooldownMinute: In-game minutes before the same cub can be petted again. This also applies after it is tamed.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearRideDistance_tool: Tiles. A following cub gets into the vehicle with its owner if it is at most this far away.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearRoamRadius_toolti: How far a bear on Roam free may stray from the spot where you gave the order.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTameFavoriteBonus: Percent more trust for honey and fish.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTameFeedPoints_to: How much the taming bar grows when you feed the cub (out of 100). Honey and fish give more, small snacks less.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTameMinFeedings_t: The cub must be fed at least this often before it is fully tamed. Until then the bar stops at 99.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTameMixBonus_tool: Percent more trust when the previous action was the other one (feeding after petting, or petting after feeding).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTamePetPoints_too: How much the taming bar grows when you pet the cub. Petting is only possible once the cub has been fed.
